## What changed

0.3.7 is in the index at `https://hotloop.io/hotloop-codesys/`, published on 2026-11-23.

- **It wraps HotLoop 4.22.0,** which gives every OPC UA PubSub device on one address and port a shared socket, so two listeners can sit on one UDP port.
- **The provisioner takes two listeners on one port.** Provisioner 0.3.2 no longer turns away a profile that puts two `opcua-pubsub` devices on one port.

What it means for you: a profile with several PubSub publishers on one port installs and reads.

## What was checked

A fresh install with a profile of the runtime's own device, two PubSub listeners on the same UDP port, an alarm and a screen, beside a real CODESYS Control for Linux SL 4.22.0.0 runtime running the Transmitter library: everything was made with no hand step, the PLC's variables read good, the alarm raised on the PLC's own value, and both listeners read connected. Against a real publisher in both encodings every one of the 32 fields read good and equal to the PLC. Both pods deleted and the runtime restarted: HotLoop came back by itself with its three devices.
